description: We are Jovidon and Nuriddin, a motivated team from Tajikistan 🇹🇯 passionate about programming, technology, and space exploration. We have interests in PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, web development, and scientific research. Our goal is to use NASA's open data to explore innovative solutions inspired by the Pamir Mountains. We welcome teammates skilled in Python, GIS, satellite data analysis, UI/UX design, and astronomy. Let's build something meaningful together!
